structured.answer: I'd pick option ב, the one list from cheapest to most expensive, because next to each name it says what kind of track it is, and in it I saw "אשראי ואג"ח" and "כספי (שקלי)". But I'm not moving anything without asking you or the bank.

stuck.why: It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' and English letters, and every line shows 'מניות 99%'. It felt like it wasn't for me and I nearly left.
The first big number, '13.79%' and 'מיליארד ₪', made me nervous instead of explaining anything.
Hard to read even with glasses on and the browser enlarged.
I was tired and didn't go on to the fifth screen.
